summary: gh pr merge --delete-branch removes the local branch and the git worktree checked out on it. When that is the Concord-managed worktree, every later Concord call fails with 'signed directory/worktree is not a git repository', and work_start cannot bootstrap because its own project-resolve runs from the dead path.
title: Never pass --delete-branch to gh pr merge while a Concord worktree holds that branch
